title: Financial Services and General Government and National Security, State, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2026

errors.claim: Bars U.S. contributions to the UN Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) through March 25, 2027
errors.problem: The 'through March 25, 2027' framing implies the entire UNRWA bar sunsets on that date. The source bars prior-year and FY2026 amounts with NO end date (indefinite); only FY2027 amounts are freed after March 25, 2027. (The Division C section detail states this correctly, so the top-line/changes.removed compression is the imprecise surface.)
errors.sourceTruth: funds ... may not be used for a contribution, grant, or other payment to the United Nations Relief and Works Agency ... (1) for any amounts provided in prior fiscal years or in fiscal year 2026; or (2) for amounts provided in fiscal year 2027, until March 25, 2027.
